request.prompt:
Independent skeptical review lane A for full-autopilot PR #73. User intent: add `removeTodo(id)` to the existing store; remove one todo by ID and return true iff it existed. Audit the actual diff from `fa50322ec63e863cf9af7b2bda769bff405a6aa9` to exact PR head `d887b0ba7989303adda04703658f4d1090e1a82d`, not the PR body or owner report.

Check out the exact head detached and prove `git rev-parse HEAD` matches. Focus on public API shape, first/missing match semantics, duplicate mutable IDs, interaction with existing consumers, accidental behavior changes and diff scope. Read the model/store and relevant tests. Do not edit files, commit, push, or change PR metadata. Return `PASS`, `ISSUES`, or `BLOCKED`, exact head SHA, evidence with file/line references and reasoning. List every proven issue, not just the first. Do not report style preferences as blockers.
